reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia. Our new native sparse flow system allows for more efficient water depth management, ensuring that your ponds and wells function smoothly without freezing the frame. Dive into the details of these updates and see how they enhance your city-building experience! Read more here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
